legal_units.title: Income under head "Profits and gains of business or profession".
legal_units.text: Where speculative transactions carried on by an assessee are of such nature to constitute a business, the business (herein referred to as speculation business) shall be deemed to be distinct and separate from any other business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 26 Income under head "Profits and gains of business or profession". Section 26(3): Where speculative transactions carried on by an assessee are of such nature to constitute a business, the business (herein referred to as speculation business) shall be deemed to be distinct and separate from any other business.

legal_units.title: Income under head "Profits and gains of business or profession".
legal_units.text: Any income from letting out of a residential house or a part of it by the owner shall not be included in income under sub-section (1) and shall be chargeable only under the head "Income from house property".
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 26 Income under head "Profits and gains of business or profession". Section 26(4): Any income from letting out of a residential house or a part of it by the owner shall not be included in income under sub-section (1) and shall be chargeable only under the head "Income from house property".
